slots.name: stab wounds
slots.sentence: The victim was stabbed about a dozen times, on his head, chest and arms, causing internal bleeding, the authorities said, and a man who tried to intervene was also stabbed.

slots.name: Larsen age
slots.sentence: Federal prosecutors in Salt Lake City said Peter Larsen, 48, was indicted in connection with a stabbing on July 13 at the mall, in West Valley City.
